### 2026-10-08 – # First Session and Entry 🎉

**3h**

# First Session and Entry 🎉

Yaaay! I finally was able to have some time to work on this project!!

I am so new to hardware and PCB, so I had to follow the Starbie tutorial, but I decided that I will add my own twist into it, by making it into an UFO rather than a star!! Hence, it is called Astrobie 🙂‍↕️

## What I did today
The following are the things I did:
- Downloaded KiCad, and did all the installations that were necessary.
- Followed the guide, in which I completed the schematics...

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/s5X6uAidfBv2Me3zVHdgxREVUKqtvsIM/3ae0151c70618f887b8409877885c5b84e759ec7652e9966561dab55c23c94df.png)
- ... and the PCB design.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/s5X6uAidfBv2Me3zVHdgxREVUKqtvsIM/6091be46bef418cc737e705cb6b2b922338767344636e52e034eaa3a5a716796.png)

As seen in the image above, I did the required wiring, and I tried to be organized and clean with it at first, but it became messy really quick, with some of the wirings having to take a really big "detour" around the board. I might redesign the board or rearrange the components later on if needed to improve this.

I also managed to run the DRC, but I got WAY more than the expected two errors 😔, so I will look into that next session, which will be tomorrow!

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/s5X6uAidfBv2Me3zVHdgxREVUKqtvsIM/827339d106d7b996b52b1fe2495678d1e670733afddb8db2bbadb0e119915019.png)

## Tasks for next session
- Fix the errors that the DRC detected
- Reorganize the wiring --> Maybe move around the components to facilitate this
- Keep working on the project!

I am really excited to see hot the final product will turn out!!
